scenes.title: Nur die Nachbarin von nebenan
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbor returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: Ein General mit Schürze
scenes.summary: At six o'clock Wednesday morning, Tessa sits with her ankle on pillows directing Owen's bread kneading and Hannah's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Karotten nach Millimetermaß
scenes.summary: Caleb chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Owen and Tessa tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Zimmer neun wird eingedeckt
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Hannah, Evelyn, and Graham lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and green leaves on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Weg mit der Rede
scenes.summary: At five to three, Arthur nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Hannah and Graham convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: Der Denkmalschutz-Stempel
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit cafe tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form and asks Evelyn to play.

scenes.title: Ein Trinkspruch in der Küche
scenes.summary: Listening to Evelyn's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Tessa, Caleb, and Owen clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: Die Melodie am Gartentor
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Arthur, Hannah, and Evelyn learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Arthur's aunt thirty years ago.
